ns2:course.label: Mapping Inequalities
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in Inequality & Cultural Understanding. Immerses students in the history of Inequality in the United States through mapping the geographic, historical, and/or social movement of minority cultures using quantitative and social science methods. Topics vary by section, but each section emphasizes experiential learning through community-engaged scholarship, field-trips, or computer programming projects. No previous computer programming experience is required. No previous computer programming experience is required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No previous computer programming experience is required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Inequality, Quantitative Reasoning II, Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
